Ben —

Thanks for the detailed notes and for flagging this early. We should absolutely try a documented coaching approach before pursuing PIP. From an HR/compliance perspective please include the following in the plan you share with Rishi:

- Clear, measurable objectives (example: "improve QA acceptance rate to >= 90% for the next two sprints")
- Concrete examples of past misses and expected behaviour changes (you already have these in the attachment)
- Timeline with checkpoints (I recommend a 4-week coaching period with weekly one-on-ones)
- Consequences and next steps if there is insufficient improvement (transparent but not punitive language)
- Offer of support (mentorship pairing, pairing sessions, and concrete resources)

I've attached a short template (I can also share via Drive) and a suggested message body you can use. Avoid language that implies a final warning; instead frame it as "focused performance plan". HR will keep the record.

Attachments: hr-coaching-template.docx

If you want I can join the kickoff 1:1 next week and serve as a neutral note-taker.

—Monica
